<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Prepare a Node.js release version and changelog without building or publishing.
Dispatches the calling workflow at the prepared tag; that run can invoke CI and publication.
See [the release guide](../../docs/usage/releases.md).

### Permissions

- **`actions`**: `write`
- **`contents`**: `write`
- **`pull-requests`**: `read`

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- inputs:start -->

## Inputs

### Workflow Call Inputs

| **Input**               | **Description**                                                                                            | **Required** | **Type**   | **Default** |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ---------- | ----------- |
| **`versioning`**        | Tool applying the HoverKraft release plan, npm for a single package or lerna for fixed-version workspaces. | **false**    | **string** | `npm`       |
| **`working-directory`** | Project directory relative to the caller repository root.                                                  | **false**    | **string** | `.`         |
| **`environment`**       | GitHub environment permitting release preparation on the default branch and release tags.                  | **false**    | **string** | `release`   |

<!-- inputs:end -->
<!-- secrets:start -->

## Secrets

| **Secret**         | **Description**                                                                                                                           | **Required** |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| **`github-token`** | Optional token for pushing release commits and dispatching the caller at the tag. Its identity must be permitted by branch and tag rules. | **false**    |

<!-- secrets:end -->
<!-- outputs:start -->

## Outputs

| **Output**     | **Description**                                                                                    |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`status`**   | no-changes, dispatched, released or ready. Only ready should start CI and publication in this run. |
| **`tag`**      | Prepared release tag.                                                                              |
| **`packages`** | JSON package list for the CI workflow's packages input. Available when status is ready.            |

<!-- outputs:end -->
